title: When Someone Is Lying Straight to Your Face
description: Doug walks into the living room. Green is on the couch eating chocolate cake, Doug's cake box hidden behind his hip. Doug: "Did you eat my cake?" Green: "What? No." Doug looks at the cake on the fork; Green slowly lowers it: "I haven't even seen your cake." Doug looks at the box, back at Green's frosting-smeared mouth. Green: "Why are you looking at me like that?" Silence, push in, a piece of cake falls from his mouth onto his shirt. Both look down. Green, dead serious: "...That's not mine." Doug's long deadpan stare. Cut to black.

revisions.text: V2: Doug eye acting follows the evidence with head moves and blinks; clearly visible crumb fall in a medium shot that both notice; Green freezes then recovers; fewer repeated close-ups; exact ending with Doug stare, slow blink, ~0.85 s hold, cut to black.

versions.notes: V2: Doug's gaze and head follow fork, box, frosting and face with natural blinks; crumb slips from Green's lip, falls and lands on his shirt in a medium shot, both look down; Green freezes then recovers for '...That's not mine.'; varied camera (wider Doug, medium crumb shot, MCU on final line); Doug's final stare with slow blink and ~0.85 s hold; fixed Green's brows poking through his beanie.
